findings.fix: Prove the inequality in ℝ≥0 as a separate `have` (with `field_simp`/`gcongr`), then lift it to ENNReal in one step with `exact_mod_cast` / `norm_cast` (using `ENNReal.coe_inv` side conditions via `simp`). A cleaner option is to add a reusable lemma `p⁻¹ ≤ ((m+1)p)⁻¹ + m/n` for `n ≤ (m+1)p`.
findings.issue: The `h₁` proof uses `rw [← ENNReal.coe_natCast .., ← ENNReal.coe_natCast m, ← ENNReal.coe_inv hp0, ← ENNReal.coe_inv hr0, ← ENNReal.coe_inv hn.ne', ← ENNReal.coe_mul, ← ENNReal.coe_add, ENNReal.coe_le_coe]`. This seven-lemma coercion chain to move the goal into ℝ≥0 breaks if Mathlib renames or reorders any of them.

summary: The PR repeats the same Lp-to-function wrapper four times and keeps two of the copies private, so callers re-inline them. The two new memLp_top proofs are near-duplicates, and the W^{m+1,p} exponent proof relies on a brittle ENNReal coercion rewrite chain.
